# EaseCation Design AI index

Public package: `@easecation/design`
Runtime has no Tailwind, Router, Capacitor or business API dependency.

## Components
- ThemeProvider [beta/foundation]: @easecation/design; platforms: web, pwa, android-webview, ios-wkwebview, windows-webview2, ssr
- Button [beta/foundation]: @easecation/design; platforms: web, pwa, android-webview, ios-wkwebview, windows-webview2, ssr
- Input [beta/input]: @easecation/design; platforms: web, pwa, android-webview, ios-wkwebview, windows-webview2, ssr

## Rules
- Reuse registered components before creating new UI.
- Keep APIs domain-neutral and SSR-safe.
- Do not import EaseCation private APIs, URLs, logos or restricted assets.
- Run `pnpm ai:validate` before review.
